declare @TableName sysname = 'Contact'
declare @Result varchar(max) = 'public class ' + @TableName + '
{'

select @Result = @Result + '
    public ' + ColumnType + NullableSign + ' ' + ColumnName + ' { get; set; }
'
from
(
    select 
        replace(col.name, ' ', '_') ColumnName,
        column_id ColumnId,
        case typ.name 
            when 'bigint' then 'long'
            when 'binary' then 'byte[]'
            when 'bit' then 'bool'
            when 'char' then 'string'
            when 'date' then 'DateTime'
            when 'datetime' then 'DateTime'
            when 'datetime2' then 'DateTime'
            when 'datetimeoffset' then 'DateTimeOffset'
            when 'decimal' then 'decimal'
            when 'float' then 'double'
            when 'image' then 'byte[]'
            when 'int' then 'int'
            when 'money' then 'decimal'
            when 'nchar' then 'string'
            when 'ntext' then 'string'
            when 'numeric' then 'decimal'
            when 'nvarchar' then 'string'
            when 'real' then 'float'
            when 'smalldatetime' then 'DateTime'
            when 'smallint' then 'short'
            when 'smallmoney' then 'decimal'
            when 'text' then 'string'
            when 'time' then 'TimeSpan'
            when 'timestamp' then 'long'
            when 'tinyint' then 'byte'
            when 'uniqueidentifier' then 'Guid'
            when 'varbinary' then 'byte[]'
            when 'varchar' then 'string'
            else 'UNKNOWN_' + typ.name
        end ColumnType,
        case 
            when col.is_nullable = 1 and typ.name in ('bigint', 'bit', 'date', 'datetime', 'datetime2', 'datetimeoffset', 'decimal', 'float', 'int', 'money', 'numeric', 'real', 'smalldatetime', 'smallint', 'smallmoney', 'time', 'tinyint', 'uniqueidentifier') 
            then '?' 
            else '' 
        end NullableSign
    from sys.columns col
        join sys.types typ on
            col.system_type_id = typ.system_type_id AND col.user_type_id = typ.user_type_id
    where object_id = object_id(@TableName)
) t
order by ColumnId

set @Result = @Result  + '
}'

print @Result

Задача:

Необходимо создать механизм выявления присутствия персональных данных в комментариях внутри СУП. Парсить нужно по следующим полям:

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.GetColumnCaptions ( @table NVARCHAR(MAX), @lang NVARCHAR(10))
RETURNS
 @returnList TABLE ([Name] [nvarchar] (500), [Caption] [nvarchar] (500), [Type] [nvarchar] (500), [Table] [nvarchar] (500))
AS
BEGIN

 INSERT INTO @returnList
 SELECT  
    c.name AS [Column], 
    REPLACE((
		select top 1 Name 
		from dbo.splitstring(convert(nvarchar(max),ep.value))
		where Name like @lang + '%'
	), @lang + '|', '') AS [Value],
	(
		select top 1 convert(nvarchar(max),ep.value) from 
			sys.columns AS c1 INNER JOIN 
			sys.all_objects O ON c1.object_id = O.object_id LEFT JOIN 
			sys.extended_properties EP ON ep.major_id = c1.object_id AND ep.minor_id = c1.column_id   
		WHERE
			O.name = @table
			and c1.Name = c.Name
			and ep.name = 'TS.EntitySchemaColumn.DataValueType'
	) as [Type],

	(Select top 1 
		(Select name From sys.objects Where object_id = D.referenced_object_id) As fk_table
		From sys.objects As C2
		Left Join (Select * From sys.foreign_key_columns) As D On D.constraint_object_id = C2.object_id 
		Where C2.parent_object_id = (Select object_id From sys.objects Where type = 'U'
		And name = @table) 
		and (Select name From sys.columns Where column_id = D.parent_column_id And object_id = D.parent_object_id) = c.Name) as [Table]
FROM 
    sys.columns AS c INNER JOIN 
    sys.all_objects O ON c.object_id = O.object_id LEFT JOIN 
    sys.extended_properties EP ON ep.major_id = c.object_id AND ep.minor_id = c.column_id   
WHERE
    O.name = @table
	and ep.name = 'TS.EntitySchemaColumn.Caption'

 RETURN
END

 @returnList TABLE ([Name] [nvarchar] (500))

 WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @stringToSplit) > 0

  SELECT @name

END

DECLARE @SQL nvarchar(max)

DECLARE @SQL_WHILE nvarchar(max)

DECLARE @TableName nvarchar(max)

DECLARE @FieldName nvarchar(max)

SET @SQL_WHILE = ' NOT IN (

                    ''1A778E3F-0A8E-E111-84A3-00155D054C03'' -- ''ru-RU''

                    ,''A5420246-0A8E-E111-84A3-00155D054C03'' -- ''en-US''

                )'

DECLARE TableFildCursor CURSOR LOCAL FORWARD_ONLY

FOR

    --Узнать, какие таблицы ссылаются на SysCulture

    SELECT DISTINCT

        CONSTRAINT_COLUMN_USAGE.TABLE_NAME AS [TABLE_NAME],

        CONSTRAINT_COLUMN_USAGE.COLUMN_NAME as [COLUMN_NAME]

    FROM

        (

            (

                INFORMATION_SCHEMA.CONSTRAINT_COLUMN_USAGE AS CONSTRAINT_COLUMN_USAGE

                INNER JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS AS TABLE_CONSTRAINTS

            ON

                CONSTRAINT_COLUMN_USAGE.CONSTRAINT_NAME = TABLE_CONSTRAINTS.CONSTRAINT_NAME

            )

            INNER JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS AS REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS

            ON

                CONSTRAINT_COLUMN_USAGE.CONSTRAINT_NAME = REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS.CONSTRAINT_NAME

        )

        INNER JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS AS PARENT_TABLES

        ON

            REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS.UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT_NAME = PARENT_TABLES.CONSTRAINT_NAME

    WHERE

        TABLE_CONSTRAINTS.CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'FOREIGN KEY'

    AND

        PARENT_TABLES.TABLE_NAME = 'SysCulture'

 

OPEN TableFildCursor

FETCH NEXT FROM TableFildCursor

INTO

    @TableName

    ,@FieldName

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0

BEGIN

    --Удаляем записи ссылающиеся на культуру

    set @SQL = '

    DELETE

        [' + @TableName + ']

    WHERE

        [' + @FieldName + ']'+ @SQL_WHILE

    exec sp_executesql @SQL

    --конец делания

    FETCH NEXT FROM TableFildCursor

    INTO

        @TableName

        ,@FieldName

END

CLOSE TableFildCursor

DEALLOCATE TableFildCursor

 

-- Удаляем лишние культуры

DELETE

FROM

    [SysCulture]

WHERE

    [Name] <> 'ru-RU'

AND

    [Name] <> 'en-US'

OR

    [Id] <> '1A778E3F-0A8E-E111-84A3-00155D054C03' -- 'ru-RU'

4. Остановить 2-3 IIS

7. Подготовительные работы БД RMS_TV CI/CD
8. Установка релиза RMS_TV
9. Запуск 1 IIS
10. Полная перекомпиляция (WebConsole)
11. Сбросить кэш в Redis
12. Скопировать данные на 2-3 IIS
13. Бэкап Log всех IIS
